cards.title: Reading the table
cards.problem: At which rank do human and lion separate?

steps.text: They share kingdom, phylum and class. They first differ at order.

cards.title: A key to five animals
cards.problem: Identify camel, lion, tilapia, frog and housefly with paired choices.

steps.text: No backbone and six legs: housefly. Fins and gills: tilapia. Moist skin: frog. Hump: camel. Hair and no hump: lion.

cards.answer: Use fixed features, not colour or size.

cards.title: Viruses are not in a kingdom
body: A virus is not a cell. It reproduces only inside a host cell, so it is not placed in any kingdom.
